key_fields.name: TRAN-CAT-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 60-byte transaction category reference record (6-byte key + 50 + 4 bytes); CBTRN03C reads the TRANCATG KSDS into it.

key_fields.name: TRAN-CAT-KEY
key_fields.meaning: Composite record key: transaction type code followed by category code.

key_fields.name: TRAN-TYPE-CD
key_fields.meaning: 2-character transaction type code, first part of the category key (same code as TRAN-TYPE in CVTRA03Y).

key_fields.name: TRAN-CAT-CD
key_fields.meaning: 4-digit numeric transaction category code within the type, second part of the key.

key_fields.name: TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC
key_fields.meaning: 50-character description of the type/category combination; printed (truncated to 29 characters) in the transaction report detail line.

observations.text: TRAN-TYPE-CD and TRAN-CAT-CD have the same names as fields of TRAN-RECORD in CVTRA05Y, so CBTRN03C, which copies both members, must qualify them with OF TRAN-RECORD / OF FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY. Confirmed.
The 50-character TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC is moved into the 29-character TRAN-REPORT-CAT-DESC, truncating category descriptions on the report.

purpose: CVTRA04Y defines TRAN-CAT-RECORD, the 60-byte transaction category reference record (header comment states RECLN = 60, matching PIC sizes 2 + 4 + 50 + 4). Its key TRAN-CAT-KEY combines the 2-character transaction type code and the 4-digit category code, and it carries a 50-character category description. In the application source it is copied only by CBTRN03C, which reads the TRANCATG KSDS by type + category to print the category description and abends if the key is not found.
